scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,worker -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev -w @oripa/api" "npm run dev -w @oripa/web" "npm run dev -w @oripa/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @oripa/shared && npm run build -w @oripa/api && npm run build -w @oripa/web && npm run build -w @oripa/worker
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @oripa/api && npm run lint -w @oripa/web && npm run lint -w @oripa/worker
